_meta.note: KAS 0.66.58 (the @kiro/agent package.json kiro-cli 2.33.1 installs) reached through `kiro-cli acp --agent-engine v3 --auth-method cli`, the production relay spawn, driven over stdio by a scratch client. Agent-to-client lines verbatim and in order, except: the session id is replaced with a fixed synthetic value, every engine-minted uuid with a numbered synthetic one, the scratch work dir reads as /work and the home directory as ~. Host inventory frames are omitted (_kiro/mcp/status, _kiro/powers/items_changed, _kiro/steering/documents_changed, _kiro/sessions/changed, _kiro/governance/state, _kiro/progressive_context/items_changed, _kiro/policy/changed, available_commands_update, config_option_update, every session_info_update, and every _kiro/tools/didChange but the last, which follows session/set_mode and lists the bound agent's tool tags). KAS's initialize carries no agentInfo, so no agent name is recorded. The session/new response is kept TRIMMED to sessionId, modes.currentModeId and the probe's own availableModes entry; the rest lists the host's agents and entitlements. A crewmate worker's kit: the spec is mate_worker.merge_worker_spec(base, worker_additions(base, mate)), the merge resolve_worker_spec runs, for a worker base kirocrew-mate-worker with tools [read, shell] and a crewmate file adding a prompt (asked for its tools, list them and end with worker kit juniper) and excludedTools [shell]. It was projected with build_kas_custom_agents (customAgents entry tools [read, shell], excludedTools [shell]), sent on session/new and activated with session/set_mode `kirocrew-mate-worker`. The last _kiro/tools/didChange lists only the read tag, and asked `Which tools do you have?` the model listed read tools only, no execute_bash, and ended with worker kit juniper: the crewmate's prompt addition was applied and its switched-off tool withheld. A control run without the crewmate's excludedTools (not kept) listed tags [read, shell] and named execute_bash.
